summary: Correct the debug escape markers for newline and tab characters.
explanation:
The shared write_escaped_cp mapping assigns '\r' to newline and '\n' to tab, so debug formatting emits the wrong markers across characters, strings, string views, and precision-limited strings. In debug_presentation, formatting "
" with {:*<5.3?} and {:*<5.4?} produces ""\r**" and ""\r"*" instead of the asserted ""\n**" and ""\n"*"; formatting "A	👈🤯ы猫" with {:*^14?} emits \n where the assertion expects \t. In format_char, {:?} on '
' produces "'\r'" instead of "'\n'". In format_string, {:?} on std::string("	est") produces ""\nest"" instead of ""\test"". In format_string_view, {:?} on string_view("t
st") produces ""t\rst"" instead of ""t\nst"". Correcting the central mapping restores the expected escapes while preserving the existing carriage-return escape.
